changelog: Signed updates (ed25519), working rollback, ops workstation upgrade
notes: TEMPLATE — NOT A PUBLISHABLE MANIFEST. The live manifest is generated at release time by scripts/publish-update.sh and uploaded straight to the update server; this tracked copy only documents the schema. Every 'size' is 0 and every 'sha256'/'sig' is empty on purpose: a client refuses a manifest whose size is 0 and refuses a library whose ed25519 signature does not verify, so serving this file by accident fails closed instead of installing anything. Regenerate before a release: sign each built library with scripts/sign-update.sh (which prints the sha256/size/sig triple for each platform) and paste the values in, or let scripts/publish-update.sh emit the whole file.
